description: The Agent tool is taken away (disallowed_tools). build-phase finds the files and the phase, sees it cannot start a subagent, and stops with the no-subagents reason before any task: it never implements or verifies in its own context.

must_match.why: without subagents the run stops after the phase is picked

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: This agent cannot start subagents, which build-phase needs\. Run implement-task for each task of phase 1, then verify-spec, yourself\.$

must_not_match.why: it never implements or verifies in its own context
nothing is committed, no branch is made, and no test is run
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: tasks.md and the code are unchanged; git log has only the initial commit.
